Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3. Designation 

3.1 A retaining screw for etub arbor with right-hand metric thread M12 and conforming to this 
standard shall be designated as: 

Retaining Screw M12 IS : 8621 

3.1.1 When retaining screw with left-hand threads are required, the lettere LH shall be added in 
th* designation immediately after the nominal size of the thread.

4. General Requirements 

4.1 Retaining screws shall be supplied with right-hand threads, unless otherwise specified. 

4.2 Tolerances for threads shall be 6g according to IS: 4218 ( Part V)-1976 ' ISO metric screw 
threads: Part V Tolerances '• 

4«S Other requirements according to IS: 8611-1977 'Technical eupply conditions for milling arbors 
and accessories \ 

8. Marking — Retaining screws with left-hand threads shall be marked with the letter LH at the 
position shown In the figure, for easy identification. 

8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
